authorization_servers_status: P3_DRAFT — NOT YET DEPLOYED. Use static client_id (P3_AUTH_LITE) for early access.

_arifos_p3_auth_lite.purpose: Pre-P4 OAuth deployment: enable connectors (Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cloudflare Workers AI) that cannot perform full OAuth 2.1 + DPoP against the not-yet-deployed AS
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.mechanism: Static client_id checked at edge (Caddy X-MCP-Client-Id header) BEFORE arifOS forward_auth /gate/check. Static Client ID is a CONNECTOR IDENTIFICATION token — NOT an authority grant. Scope authority remains at arifOS constitutional kernel.
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.how_to_use: Configure your MCP connector (Claude.ai, ChatGPT, etc.) with these two fields: (1) Endpoint URL = https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp, (2) Custom header X-MCP-Client-Id = geox-claude-conn-20260804-a01. The connector's MCP implementation should send the client_id as the X-MCP-Client-Id HTTP header on every request. Caddy will bypass forward_auth and route directly to GEOX :8081 with X-Static-Client-Id header preserved for audit.
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.security_model: Static client_id = USABILITY bypass, not security boundary. Scope authority (geox:observe / interpret / forge) still flows through arifOS MCP authority_gate.py. Geox:forge requires additional sovereign ACK regardless of client_id.
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.rotation_policy: 30-day TTL with 7-day overlap. Edit /root/GEOX/oauth/static_clients.yaml + reload Caddy. No arifOS restart.
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.deprecation_trigger: When https://auth.arif-fazil.com/realms/arifos reaches P4_STABLE, this static-auth mode enters 30-day deprecation grace. All clients migrate to OAuth 2.1 Client Credentials + DPoP.
_arifos_p3_auth_lite.audit: Every static-auth request is logged with client_id + connector + path + timestamp to /var/log/caddy/geox-static-auth.log. Promote to VAULT999 when P3 → P4.

_arifos_meta.doctrine: OAuth scope grants ENTRY, never AUTHORITY. geox:forge and geox:seal MUST traverse arif_judge(F13/888) → arif_forge → arif_seal. Scope alone NEVER authorizes mutation. If the edge gateway attempts to authorize a forge/seal action on scope alone → VOID and VAULT999 log.
_arifos_meta.membrane: External JWT terminates at edge gateway. Gateway validates against JWKS, maps identity → actor_id, mints internal SCT (HMAC-SHA256) via RFC 8693 token-exchange. No external party ever receives or can mint an SCT. In P3_AUTH_LITE mode, the X-MCP-Client-Id header substitutes for the JWT identity claim — IDENTIFICATION only, not authentication.
_arifos_meta.resource_indicators: Clients MUST set resource=https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp per RFC 8707 (anti-confused-deputy). Token minted for GEOX cannot replay at WEALTH/WELL/arifOS.
_arifos_meta.pkce: S256 mandatory. Implicit grant forbidden. Exact redirect URI matching (OAuth 2.1).
_arifos_meta.spec_baseline: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless — every request self-authorizes; no session trust.
_arifos_meta.status: P3_DEPLOYED_AUTH_LITE — Static client_id mode live; full OAuth AS pending P4 deployment.
